## Actions

- Consolidated experimentation request flows into the Admin Hub portal.
- Feature-led the Loom in Admin Hub Global Requests experiment as solo engineer, resolving Growth and Admin Hub architecture and API tradeoffs and enabling parallel experiment and Admin Hub API workstreams.

## Scope

Established foundational data storage capabilities for future virality and grant-access experimentation initiatives, and delivered Loom support through Admin Hub request surfaces spanning xflow and admin task service.

## Outcomes

- Zero-incident, zero-restart launch across three Cross Flow experiments for the Admin Hub Global Requests work.

## Metrics

- day-1 to day-6 active instances (D1D6AI) increase: 35%
- first-week active instances increase: +412
- projected monthly end-user requests supported: ~7000

## Technologies

Admin Hub, experimentation request flows, data storage, xflow, admin task service, Statsig, Unified Requests, Loom
